```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(targets)
library(mclust)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

RESOLUTIONS <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7)

get_type_legend <- function(p) {
  cowplot::get_legend(
    p + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1), ncol = 1)))
}
```

```{r data-load}
tar_load(anno_meta_hsc)
tar_load(annotation_recluster_hsc)
hsc_df <- anno_merge_recluster(anno_meta_hsc, annotation_recluster_hsc)
rm(anno_meta_hsc, annotation_recluster_hsc)
gc()
```

Reference-based label transfer for the HSC compartment. Each section loads its reference and projection independently, plots all panels, then cleans up before the next.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Ferchen 2026 BM (mm)

```{r ferchen-load}
ref_df   <- tar_read(ferchen_26_mm_bm_umap)
proj     <- inner_join(hsc_df, tar_read(proj_ferchen_26_mm_bm_hsc))
type_pal <- anno_make_type_pal(ref_df, proj$predicted.Level2, "Level2")
```

```{r ferchen-labels, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
p_ref  <- plot_ref_umap(ref_df, type_pal, "Ferchen 2026 BM", "Level2", "UMAP")
p_proj <- plot_ref_proj_umap(proj, ref_df, type_pal, "Level2", "UMAP_", "UMAP")
cowplot::plot_grid(cowplot::plot_grid(p_ref, p_proj), get_type_legend(p_ref),
                  rel_widths = c(1, 0.22))
```

```{r ferchen-density, fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
proj %>% split(.$sample.name) %>%
  lapply(plot_query_density_umap, ref_df = ref_df, proj_key = "UMAP_", ref_key = "UMAP") %>%
  patchwork::wrap_plots(nrow = 1)
```

```{r ferchen-mapping, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
cowplot::plot_grid(plot_query_label_umap(proj, type_pal, "Level2"),
                  plot_mapping_score_umap(proj))
```

```{r ferchen-ari, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}
compute_ari_table(proj, RESOLUTIONS, "Level2") |>
  plot_ari_line("ARI — Ferchen 2026 × HSC")
```

```{r ferchen-heatmap, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ht <- plot_resolution_heatmap(proj, "predicted.Level2", RESOLUTIONS, "Ferchen 2026 × HSC")
if (!is.null(ht)) ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht)
```

```{r ferchen-cleanup}
rm(ref_df, proj, type_pal); gc()
```

## Zeng 2025 BM (hs→mm)

Cross-species projection onto the human BoneMarrowMap via PCA anchors. Query coordinates sit in the reference PCA/UMAP space (`refUMAP_1`/`refUMAP_2`); the reference itself uses `UMAP_1`/`UMAP_2`. No per-condition density panel (projection space is shared across all conditions).

```{r zeng-load}
ref_df   <- tar_read(zeng_25_hs_bm_umap)
proj     <- inner_join(hsc_df, tar_read(proj_zeng_25_hs_bm_hsc))
type_pal <- anno_make_type_pal(ref_df, proj$predicted.CellType_Broad, "CellType_Broad")
```

```{r zeng-labels, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
p_ref  <- plot_ref_umap(ref_df, type_pal, "Zeng 2025 BM", "CellType_Broad", "UMAP_")
p_proj <- plot_ref_proj_umap(proj, ref_df, type_pal, "CellType_Broad", "refUMAP_", "UMAP_")
cowplot::plot_grid(cowplot::plot_grid(p_ref, p_proj), get_type_legend(p_ref),
                  rel_widths = c(1, 0.22))
```

```{r zeng-mapping, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
cowplot::plot_grid(plot_query_label_umap(proj, type_pal, "CellType_Broad"),
                  plot_mapping_score_umap(proj))
```

```{r zeng-ari, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}

```


## SingleR

Automated label transfer using bulk RNA-seq references from `celldex`. Three references: Novershtern Haematopoietic (human, mapped to mouse orthologs), ImmGen (mouse immune atlas), Mouse RNAseq (broad types).

```{r singler-setup, message=FALSE}
library(SingleR)
library(celldex)
library(BiocParallel)

tar_load(mm_hs_ortho_long)
ref_nov  <- celldex::NovershternHematopoieticData()
ref_ig   <- celldex::ImmGenData()
ref_mrna <- celldex::MouseRNAseqData()

ortho_1to1 <- mm_hs_ortho_long |>
  dplyr::filter(human_ortho %in% rownames(ref_nov)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(human_ortho)     |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 1) |> dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::group_by(Mouse.gene.name) |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 1) |> dplyr::ungroup()
ref_nov_mm <- ref_nov[ortho_1to1$human_ortho, ]
rownames(ref_nov_mm) <- ortho_1to1$Mouse.gene.name
rm(mm_hs_ortho_long)
```

```{r singler-run, message=FALSE}
tar_load(mpn_processed_data_hsc)
expr_mat <- SeuratObject::GetAssayData(mpn_processed_data_hsc, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
rm(mpn_processed_data_hsc); gc()
singler_nov  <- SingleR(test = expr_mat, ref = ref_nov_mm, labels = ref_nov_mm$label.main,
                        BPPARAM = SerialParam())
singler_ig   <- SingleR(test = expr_mat, ref = ref_ig,     labels = ref_ig$label.main,
                        BPPARAM = SerialParam())
singler_mrna <- SingleR(test = expr_mat, ref = ref_mrna,   labels = ref_mrna$label.main,
                        BPPARAM = SerialParam())
rm(expr_mat, ref_nov, ref_ig, ref_mrna, ref_nov_mm); gc()
```

```{r singler-helpers, include=FALSE}
umap_cols <- hsc_df[, c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2")]

singler_umap <- function(pred, title) {
  pred_df <- data.frame(cell_id = rownames(pred), label = pred$labels)
  df      <- inner_join(umap_cols, pred_df, by = "cell_id")
  lvls    <- sort(unique(df$label))
  pal     <- setNames(colorRampPalette(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, min(length(lvls), 12)), "Paired"))(length(lvls)), lvls)
  cents   <- df %>%
    group_by(label) %>%
    summarise(UMAP1 = mean(UMAP1), UMAP2 = mean(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = label)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = cents, aes(label = label),
      size = 3, fontface = "bold",
      label.size = 0.2, label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
      fill = alpha("white", 0.75), max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

singler_bar <- function(pred, title) {
  as.data.frame(table(label = pred$labels)) |>
    mutate(prop = Freq / sum(Freq)) |> arrange(desc(prop)) |>
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = label, y = prop)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4393c3") +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion", title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)
}
```

### Novershtern Haematopoietic

```{r singler-nov-umap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
singler_umap(singler_nov, "HSC — Novershtern")
```

```{r singler-nov-bar, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
singler_bar(singler_nov, "Label distribution — Novershtern")
```

```{r singler-nov-delta, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}

```
